title: The Minecraft Movie
description: Four unlikely visitors are pulled into a block-built world and have to learn its rules before they can make it home.

title: The Super Mario Bros. Movie
description: Mario and Luigi tumble into the Mushroom Kingdom, where a rescue mission becomes a bright, chaotic adventure.
tagline: A warp pipe into pure color.

title: Godzilla vs. Kong
description: Two ancient titans collide while people race to uncover the force pulling them toward a world-shaking fight.
tagline: Titans do not share the throne.

title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
description: Miles Morales races through the Spider-Verse as every choice starts to pull against the future he wants.

title: Jurassic Park
description: A dream park built on prehistoric science turns dangerous when its attractions escape their fences.

title: Ice Age
description: A mismatched herd crosses a frozen world and finds family in the middle of a very weird migration.

title: Iron Lung
description: After the Quiet Rapture erases every known star and habitable planet, a convict is sealed inside the Iron Lung, a small submarine sent to explore an ocean of blood on a desolate moon.
tagline: No windows. No rescue. Keep moving.
